title: Identification of Apple Leaf Diseases by Improved Deep Convolutional Neural Networks With an Attention Mechanism.
summary: A coordinate-attention EfficientNet model classifies apple leaf diseases on a collected dataset and is compared with conventional CNNs on held-out images; this is an application-specific plant-disease detection result, not a new disease biology finding.
ai_technology: CA-ENet deep CNN combines coordinate attention with EfficientNet for disease-image classification.
